say:1:1130102001:1.text: Our settlement is on the edge of the desert and was once considered barren land by other clans. If Magister Merlin hadn't created the oasis, no one could live here.
say:1:1130102001:1.source_cn: 我们的聚落在荒漠边缘，本来是其他部落瞧不上的贫瘠之地。...
say:1:1130102001:1.male: Our settlement is on the edge of the desert and was once considered barren land by other clans. If Magister Merlin hadn't created the oasis, no one could live here.
say:1:1130102001:1.female: Our settlement is on the edge of the desert and was once considered barren land by other clans. If Magister Merlin hadn't created the oasis, no one could live here.

say:2:1130102002:1.text: After Pops passed away, Alsa and Soren stepped up and have always made sure we had food.
say:2:1130102002:1.source_cn: 聚落的食物，在老爹去世后，一直都是凭靠阿尔萨姐姐和索恩...

say:3:1130102003:1.text: When there's no food nearby, sometimes they have to go really far to get some.
say:3:1130102003:1.source_cn: 当附近没有食物时，他们只能去到更远处。

say:4:1130102004:1.text: Maybe we should do something nice for them so that they don't have to worry all the time.
say:4:1130102004:1.source_cn: 或许我们应该做些什么，帮哥哥姐姐减轻压力。
